english.title: Licensed operator - operate a vehicle as PHV without a current licence - outside London
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a person licensed under section 55 of the Local Government (Miscellaneous Provisions) Act 1976, in a controlled district operated a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), as a private hire vehicle while no current licence under section 48 of the Act was in force for the vehicle
english.legislation: Contrary to section 46(1)(e)(i) and (2) and 76 of the Local Government (Miscellaneous Provisions) Act 1976.
